prompt: Which component sits at the heart of the AI-first Power Platform architecture as the unified, governed data layer that AI capabilities are grounded in?

options.text: Microsoft Dataverse
Microsoft Power BI
Microsoft AI Builder
Microsoft Power Pages

explanation: Dataverse ist die vereinheitlichte Datenschicht der Plattform. Wenn ein Agent einen Kundendatensatz nachschlägt, ein Prompt Geschäftskontext braucht oder eine modellgesteuerte App Vorschläge einblendet, greift das jeweils auf Dataverse zu — deshalb ist AI-first-Design immer auch Datenarchitektur.

source.title: Explore the AI-first Power Platform
source.quote: Dataverse sits at the heart of this architecture. It's the platform's unified data layer: a governed, enterprise-grade foundation that AI capabilities are grounded in.

prompt: Match each AI-first process pattern to its description.

right.text: Primarily human-driven, but AI reduces friction at key points — the human still decides, AI does the prep work
An agent handles frontline interaction or routine steps and escalates to a human only when judgment is required
Runs from trigger to completion without human input; a human only sees it if an exception is flagged

explanation: Human-assisted: Der Mensch entscheidet, die KI bereitet vor (Felder extrahieren, Anomalien prüfen, Richtlinien einblenden). Agent-assisted: Der Agent löst die Masse selbst und eskaliert mit vollem Kontext. Fully autonomous: Trigger bis Abschluss ohne Menschen, nur Ausnahmen landen beim Menschen. Reale Lösungen mischen meist alle drei.

source.title: Map business processes to AI-first solution patterns
source.quote: Human-assisted processes are primarily human-driven, but AI reduces friction at key points. Agent-assisted processes let an agent handle frontline interaction or routine steps, escalating to a human only when the situation requires judgment. Fully autonomous processes run from trigger to completion without human input.

prompt: Contoso's finance team receives vendor invoices by email in mixed formats (PDFs and scanned images), keys the fields manually, and routes them for approval with no status visibility. Which combination does the learning content recommend?

options.text: AI Builder document extraction, a Power Automate approval flow, and a model-driven review app
A Power Pages portal with a Web Agent for vendors and a Power BI dashboard for approvers
A canvas app with an embedded Copilot Studio agent that reads the invoice PDFs
A Power Automate flow with one Condition per vendor and a canvas app for manual keying

explanation: Unstrukturierte Dokumente sind der Fall für AI Builder (Feldextraktion aus beliebigen Rechnungsformaten). Power Automate übernimmt Routing und Genehmigungslogik nach Lieferant, Betrag oder Kategorie, und eine modellgesteuerte App gibt Prüfern die Dataverse-Datensätze mit vollem Statusüberblick.

source.title: Recommend Power Platform components for business solutions
source.quote: The right approach combines AI Builder (to extract document fields automatically from any invoice format) with Power Automate (to orchestrate routing and approval logic based on vendor, amount, or category) and a Power Apps model-driven app (for reviewers to manage invoice records in Dataverse with full status visibility).

prompt: According to the requirements-to-components framework, which three of the following dimensions should you work through when you receive a business requirement? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.text: Who uses it: internal employees or external users?
What data is involved: structured, unstructured, or analytical?
Is the process human-driven or automated?
Which environment type will host the solution?
How many makers will maintain it after go-live?

explanation: Das Framework fragt vier Dimensionen ab: Wer nutzt es (intern/extern)? Welche Daten sind im Spiel (strukturiert, unstrukturiert, analytisch)? Ist der Prozess menschgetrieben oder automatisiert? Und ist natürliche Sprache beteiligt? Vertrags- oder Kapazitätsfragen gehören nicht dazu.

source.title: Recommend Power Platform components for business solutions
source.quote: Who uses it? Internal employees (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio) or external users (Power Pages, Power Pages Web Agents)? What data is involved? Structured transactional data (Dataverse, model-driven app), unstructured documents (AI Builder), or analytical aggregations (Power BI)? Is the process human-driven or automated?

prompt: Match each Power Platform extensibility option to when you should use it.

right.text: External API not in the connector catalog

explanation: Custom Connectors binden externe APIs an, die der Katalog nicht abdeckt. PCF-Komponenten liefern fehlende UI-Steuerelemente. Dataverse-Plug-ins (C#) erzwingen serverseitige Geschäftslogik kanalunabhängig. Custom APIs erweitern die Dataverse-API um benannte Geschäftsoperationen wie CalculateInvoiceRisk.

source.title: Explore extensibility options in Power Platform
source.quote: Custom connector External API not in the connector catalog Developer (IT or ISV) PCF component UI control not available natively Developer Dataverse plug-in Server-side business logic Developer Custom API Reusable business operation endpoint Developer

prompt: A functional consultant hits a requirement that no built-in Power Platform capability covers and proposes abandoning the platform for a custom web application. Which principle argues against this, and what does it imply?

options.text: The "no cliffs" principle — a supported extension path exists for every requirement beyond built-in capabilities
The "fusion team" principle — professional developers must sign off before any low-code solution is extended further
The "low-code first" principle — requirements that exceed low-code capabilities should be descoped
The "managed environment" principle — extensions are only supported inside Managed Environments

explanation: Das „no cliffs“-Prinzip besagt, dass man auf der Power Platform nie in einer Sackgasse landet: Reicht eine eingebaute Funktion nicht, gibt es immer einen unterstützten Erweiterungspfad — Custom Connectors, PCF-Komponenten, Plug-ins, Custom APIs, BYOM oder das Agents SDK. Eine komplett eigene Webanwendung ist damit fast nie nötig. Die anderen drei „Prinzipien“ existieren in dieser Form nicht.

source.title: Explore extensibility options in Power Platform
source.quote: Microsoft describes this as the "no cliffs" principle. You should never reach a dead end on Power Platform. If a built-in capability doesn't quite meet the requirement, there's always a supported way to extend it.

prompt: A team needs a fine-tuned model for a specialized domain that the built-in Power Platform models don't cover. Which extensibility option applies?

options.text: Bring Your Own Model in Prompt Builder with an Azure AI Foundry deployment
A Dataverse plug-in in C# that calls the fine-tuned model's endpoint on every save
A custom connector that wraps the fine-tuned model's REST endpoint for use in flows
The Microsoft 365 Agents SDK with the fine-tuned model wired into a pro-code agent

explanation: BYOM im Prompt Builder verbindet beliebige in Azure AI Foundry bereitgestellte Modelle. Damit werden die über 1.800 Modelle des Foundry-Katalogs für Prompts, Flows und Agents über dieselbe Low-Code-Oberfläche nutzbar. Gebaut wird das typischerweise von KI-/ML-Engineers.

source.title: Explore extensibility options in Power Platform
source.quote: Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) in Prompt Builder lets you connect any model deployed in Azure AI Foundry. The 1,800+ models in the Azure AI Foundry catalog become accessible to your prompts, flows, and agents through the same low-code interface.

prompt: Plans in Power Apps uses three specialized AI agents that work in sequence. Place them in the order they run.

items.text: Requirement Agent — generates user roles and user needs from the business problem
Data Agent — suggests Dataverse tables with columns, data types, and relationships
Solution Agent — creates the technology proposal mapping components to roles and tables

explanation: Der Requirement Agent läuft zuerst und erzeugt Benutzerrollen und Bedürfnisse. Nach deren Freigabe schlägt der Data Agent das Dataverse-Datenmodell vor. Zuletzt wertet der Solution Agent Anforderungen, Prozesse und Datenmodell aus und erstellt den Technologievorschlag.

source.title: Explore plans and the AI agents that power them
source.quote: The Requirement Agent is the first to run after you enter your prompt. It examines your business problem and generates user roles and user needs (similar to user stories). After requirements are defined, the Data Agent suggests a set of Dataverse tables to store the business information. The Solution Agent evaluates the requirements, processes, and data model to create a technology proposal.

prompt: For each of the following statements about Plans in Power Apps, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

statements.text: To use Plans, the environment needs a Dataverse database, enabled Copilot features, and an eligible locale.
Up to 100 makers can view the same plan simultaneously, but only one can edit at a time.
A maker shared at Co-Owner level can delete the plan and change its ownership.

explanation: Plans setzt Dataverse, aktivierte Copilot-Funktionen und ein zugelassenes Gebietsschema voraus. Copresence erlaubt bis zu 100 gleichzeitige Betrachter, aber nur einen Bearbeiter — der erste, der den Plan öffnet. Co-Owner dürfen nutzen, bearbeiten und teilen, aber weder löschen noch die Eigentümerschaft ändern.

source.title: Explore plans and the AI agents that power them
source.quote: To use Plans, your environment needs a Dataverse database, enabled Copilot features, and an eligible locale. Copresence: Up to 100 makers can view the same plan simultaneously, though only one can edit at a time. Sharing: Share a plan with other makers at the Viewer level (view only) or Co-Owner level (can use, edit, and share the plan, but not delete it or change ownership).

prompt: Process diagrams generated by Plans use three types of nodes. Match each node type to its purpose.

right.text: Mark the start, middle, or end of a process
Represent tasks performed by a user or system

explanation: Events markieren Anfang, Mitte und Ende eines Prozesses (z. B. Start bei Antragseinreichung). Gateways bilden Entscheidungen mit Verzweigungen ab (etwa genehmigt/abgelehnt). Activities sind Aufgaben, die ein Benutzer oder System ausführt.

source.title: Create a plan and refine the requirements
source.quote: Events Mark the start, middle, or end of a process A start event triggers when an employee submits a request Gateways Represent decisions with branching paths An exclusive gateway routes to "approved" or "rejected" Activities Represent tasks performed by a user or system Manager reviews the request details

prompt: Which prompt is the better starting point for a plan, according to the guidance on writing an effective prompt?

options.text: "Employees need to submit time-off requests and managers need to approve them."
"Create a canvas app with a form for the HR team to record employee time-off requests."
"Build three apps, two portals, and a reporting layer for the HR department."
"Use Dataverse and Power Automate to store and route employee requests."

explanation: Ein guter Prompt beschreibt das Geschäftsproblem statt der gewünschten Technik, nennt die beteiligten Rollen, liefert genug Ablaufkontext und bleibt bei einem klar umrissenen Szenario. „Create a canvas app with a form" beschreibt Technik, nicht das Problem.

source.title: Create a plan and refine the requirements
source.quote: Describes the business problem, not just the technology you want. Instead of "Create a canvas app with a form," write "Employees need to submit time-off requests and managers need to approve them."

prompt: Complete the statement about the two main components of a prompt.
textParts: is the written part of the prompt that states the task and the objective for the model, while the
is the part that provides information for the model's output, such as the intended audience and tone.

options.text: instruction
context
completion
instruction
context
grounding

explanation: Ein Prompt besteht aus Instruction und Context. Die Instruction benennt Aufgabe und Ziel („Summarize this email in three bullets"), der Context liefert die nötigen Rahmeninformationen („The email contains customer feedback from the past week") — Zielgruppe, Ton, Komplexitätsgrad.

source.title: What is prompt engineering?
source.quote: A prompt consists of two main components: instruction and context. Instruction: The instruction is the written part of the prompt that states the task and the objective for the model. Context: The context is the part of the prompt that provides information for the model's output.

prompt: Users of a model-driven app want to summarize a record with one click and generate charts from a view by describing them in natural language. The project sponsor asks whether this requires Copilot Studio licenses and custom agent configuration. What is the correct answer?

options.text: No — both agents are built into the Power Apps runtime and need neither a license nor configuration
Yes — each built-in agent must be created and published in Copilot Studio before use
Partly — summarization is built in, but chart generation needs a custom Copilot Studio agent
No — no configuration is needed, but each user interaction consumes Copilot Studio message capacity

explanation: Die aufgabenbezogenen Agents in Power Apps — Data entry, Data exploration (inkl. Diagramme aus Ansichten), Data summarization — sind in die Laufzeit eingebettet. Sie brauchen weder eine Copilot-Studio-Lizenz noch eigene Konfiguration und lassen sich direkt für App-Nutzer aktivieren.

source.title: Map business processes to AI-first solution patterns
source.quote: These agents don't require a Copilot Studio license or custom configuration. They're embedded in the Power Apps runtime and can be enabled for your app users directly.

prompt: When you create a Power Pages site from a plan, what does the guidance say about where to save it?

options.text: Save it to the same solution as the plan to keep ALM healthy
Save it to a separate solution so the site can be deployed independently
Save it outside any solution, since Power Pages sites aren't solution-aware
Save it to the default solution of the production environment

explanation: Für sauberes ALM gehört die Power-Pages-Site in dieselbe Solution wie der Plan. Speichert man in eine neue Solution, sollte man „Set this as your preferred solution in this environment" wählen, damit alles zusammenbleibt. Das Erstellen setzt außerdem die Rolle System administrator und Rechte zur App-Registrierung in Microsoft Entra voraus.

source.title: Build and manage your solution
source.quote: When saving a Power Pages site, save it to the same solution as your plan for healthy application lifecycle management (ALM). If you're saving to a new solution, select "Set this as your preferred solution in this environment" to keep everything aligned.

prompt: When you create a Copilot Studio agent from a plan, which field is populated automatically with all tables created by the plan?

options.text: Knowledge
Channels
Security roles
Environment variables

explanation: Beim Erstellen aus einem Plan füllt Copilot Studio Name, Beschreibung und Instructions vor — und trägt alle vom Plan erzeugten Tabellen automatisch als Wissensquellen (Knowledge) ein. Danach Instructions prüfen, Trigger und Aktionen ergänzen und den Agent vor dem Veröffentlichen testen.

source.title: Build and manage your solution
source.quote: Knowledge: all tables created by the plan are automatically added as knowledge sources
